scope: One-time current117 reserve_gate stored-event and accepted 51-field Gate projection correction, including its all-rollback validation bundle only
findings: The corrected function is byte-for-byte the old committed Root10 reserve_gate source except for exactly three bounded replacements: the two stored-event comparisons and the invalid GateAuthorization field projection.
Events 114 and 115 remain fixed by root, sequence, and idempotency key, while request equality now matches the actual normalized stored shape {operation,body:{binding_id,evidence}}.
The operation, binding_id, and complete evidence JSON remain exact; the correction does not accept a partial or caller-selected projection.
The event 116 chain continues to compare qualified_evidence against the unchanged invocation constant fixed_qualified_event->evidence, so no null or weakened link is introduced.

The exact accepted 51-field GateAuthorization has no gate_definition_ref. The replacement therefore keeps gate_id equal to the binding, keeps the binding gate version and digest fixed, and requires exactly one artifact_refs object equal to the accepted Gate blob URI plus the bound Gate digest.
The later fixed_ga comparison still byte-locks the complete artifact_refs array and every other accepted fixed field, so the Gate mapping neither adds a 52nd field nor allows another Gate artifact.

The immutable-aware harness leaves execution event 117 unchanged for the no-LF case and changes only the synthetic GA budget reference digest derived from the no-LF representation; the expected rejection remains root10_exact_prior_committed_budget117_required.

Historical gate_attempt mutations in N08 and N09 are attributed to the exact immutable_gate_bytes_or_decision trigger, while execution/root history mutations in N11 through N13 are attributed to immutable_control_evidence. These early trigger rejections are not represented as runtime coverage of downstream reserve_gate guards.

All other reserve_gate guards, Root/Gate/Profile/Scope/generation bindings, historical hashes, budget117, charges, one-GA limit, owner, ACL, configuration, security, volatility, kind, parallel-safety, and leakproof metadata remain unchanged.
The all-rollback bundle installs the correction separately inside each of fifteen transactions and contains fifteen BEGIN, fifteen ROLLBACK, and zero COMMIT statements.
